description.value: Proviant International Foods is an international grocery supermarket located in Coquitlam along the Barnet Highway corridor. As a specialty international foods store, it likely carries a diverse range of imported and ethnic food products that can be harder to find at mainstream supermarkets. Touring cyclists passing through the area may find it a useful stop for provisioning with a wider variety of foods.
